name: ProjectCard
summary: A piece of work: media, client and year, a title linking over the whole card, a line and discipline tags.

guidance.useFor: A portfolio's selected work, in a grid: one card per case study.
insteadUse: A card with several actions or no link: Card
content: The title is the project's name, so the link's name is short
One line on the problem and what changed

rungReason: An <article> whose heading's link stretches over the card by a pseudo-element, as Card does; no script.

a11y.name: Its heading; the link's name is the heading's text

focus.indicator: The card shows the outline while its link has focus (:has(:focus-visible))

props.title: the heading and link
props.media: a Media frame or an img

rules: One link per card; don't wrap the whole card in an <a>
Tags sit above the stretched link and aren't links themselves
Text in the card can't be selected by dragging: keep it short
contrast: An opaque surface (--lue-color-bg-surface) under increased contrast, reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter
